tasks.short: Verify property against legal descriptions and certifications

steps.what: Read the property's legal description or certification and verify its provenance
Inspect the actual property and capture its identifying marks and characteristics
Compare explicit serial numbers, dimensions and dated identifiers against the document
Resolve discrepancies and determine whether the actual property matches its description

tasks.design: Test native exact-field comparisons in the appraisal application in {OTHER}. Compare only verified identifiers and measurements, leaving document provenance, physical inspection and the actual identity conclusion with the appraiser.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated identifier comparisons accompany substantive authentication work.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed equality and unit rules can flag explicit discrepancies without authenticating property.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a genuine identity mismatch from an incomplete or misleading description.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise material, provenance and physical evidence that simple identifiers cannot establish.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated field comparison with unchanged authentication responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact identifier comparison can flag discrepancies, but cannot establish authenticity or legal identity of tangible property.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is identity verification, not a separate certification issuance. OTHER is the appraisal records application. No new verification log or outward send is imposed.

Document issuers supply descriptions; the appraiser checks source, object ID, serial, dimensions, units and relevant dates in s1 and captures actual observations in s2. Reading, extraction and field capture remain counted; missing fields require manual work.

Test native comparison rules first. Only 15 repeated manual field comparisons are removed, not existing runtime. s4 retains exception resolution and manual repair; unstructured descriptions beyond that allowance require lower savings.
No conclusion is automatically accepted. Any ordinary case note save is fully retained without an approval gate.
unknowns: Usable identifiers and actual comparison effort
research_questions: Compare a real equipment certificate to the inspected item and count extraction and mismatch work.

incremental.description: Maintain identity mappings and unit-comparison examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 repeated comparison points less 1 upkeep. An antique has no serial and a narrative certification; retain authentication and compare only 3 points of explicit dimensions and dates: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the previous appraisal and verify evidence of improvement, damage or change
Inspect the changed property and verify its actual present condition
Determine the effect of the change on the property's appraised value
Write the required updated appraisal report

loop.purpose: Restate verified changes and the appraiser's own updated rationale
loop.input: Previous appraisal, verified changes and appraiser-authored value rationale
loop.output: Draft updated appraisal with change references
loop.check: Appraiser checks condition meaning, omissions, valuation date, uncertainty and that the value and rationale are their own
loop.stop: Unsupported condition, invented value or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report fields and prior report reuse come first; variable change narrative needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Review the complete final updated appraisal and client destination
Send the approved updated appraisal to the specified client

tasks.design: Use native report reuse in {DOCS} before a bounded draft of the appraiser's verified changes and updated valuation rationale. Keep inspection and valuation human, check the complete final report, and retain the actual client send separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: A changed appraisal requires factual and explanatory restatement after the value is reassessed.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can restate supplied changes without choosing a value.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing how damage, restoration or improvement changes market value.
tasks.human_edge: Own condition assessment, comparability and the valuation conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less report restatement with unchanged appraisal accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can restate supplied appraisal changes, but valuation and condition assessment require an appraiser.

assumptions: Provisional workflow is an actual updated appraisal delivered to a client. An internal working update without a client send must be reweighted; no extra report or send is invented.

The appraiser verifies object ID, prior report version, inspection and valuation dates, condition evidence, market evidence and updated value in s1-s3. Source extraction and missing evidence remain counted. No free validated condition summary is assumed.

Native prior-report reuse is tested first. Only 4 of 20 routine report-restatement points are removed; 16 remain for input, specialist writing, correction and ordinary save, plus full final review in s5. Excess repair lowers benefits.
s5 approves the exact final report and client destination before s6. The actual send keeps its full small time, and ordinary author saves are ungated.
unknowns: Actual report-restatement share and recipient requirements
research_questions: Compare one changed appraisal with its inspection evidence and count draft corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain update-draft instructions and source-reference checks

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final updated appraisal and client destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 4 restatement points less 1 upkeep. Unusual restoration damage requires bespoke explanation; reuse only 1.5 points of factual history wording: 1.5 minus 1 = 0.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify in court about tangible property value

steps.what: Review the actual appraisal, evidence and court questions before testimony
Testify in court and answer questions about the property's value

tasks.design: Retain actual evidence review in {DOCS} and the appraiser's personal court testimony. Native access already exposes the case documents in this scenario; a summary does not replace the expert's own knowledge of the evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expert testimony requires personal command of the appraisal and direct answers under questioning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-document access helps availability but establishes no additional labour-removing operation here.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining valuation uncertainty accurately under challenge.
tasks.human_edge: Stand behind the opinion and respond honestly to unexpected questions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: property-value testimony requires the expert's own evidence review and oral responses; the court record is not an appraiser-authored activity log.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is preparation for oral testimony using an existing appraisal and then testifying. Creating or amending a written expert report is a separate actual output and must be added if required here; existing appraisal production is not shifted to free staff work.

Before zero, inspect evidence lookup, written report, filing and send boundaries. This scenario already has direct case access and no new appraiser-owned filing or transcript duty. Court recording is outside the appraiser's labour denominator.
Native case access is tested first; no repeated search baseline is invented. Full reading stays counted, and no new witness activity record or automation upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual written expert-report or filing duties within the court engagement
research_questions: Observe witness preparation and separately identify any actual report revision, lookup or filing.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 30 evidence-review and 70 testimony points. A disputed valuation still requires full evidence understanding; no established duplicate entry, report production or send is removed in this oral-testimony boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify property condition, market evidence, valuation dates and forecast inputs
Choose comparable evidence, forecast method and explicit scenario assumptions
Repeat specified depreciation or market-change scenario arithmetic and sensitivity tables
Check sensitivity results and determine the defensible forecast property value

tasks.design: Test native scenario tables in the valuation application in {OTHER} before adding code. Repeat only the appraiser's specified arithmetic; retain evidence selection, forecast assumptions, sensitivity interpretation and the final value decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scenario arithmetic is mixed with judgement about future markets and property condition.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed calculations can evaluate explicitly chosen assumptions without generating a valuation opinion.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting comparable evidence and representing uncertainty for unusual property.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which assumptions and evidence justify a forecast value.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated calculation entry with unchanged valuation responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: valuation tools can calculate specified depreciation and sensitivity scenarios; choosing a method and forecasting market value remain appraiser judgement.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is a forecast working analysis, before any separately commissioned report or client send. OTHER is the valuation calculation application. No extra forecast log is imposed.

The appraiser verifies object ID, condition date, comparable source/date, price unit, time horizon, selected method and scenario rates in s1-s2. Evidence extraction, missing observations and assumption setting remain counted, not assumed ready upstream.

Native scenario tables come first. Only 20 repeated manual calculation and table-entry points are removed; existing runtime earns no credit. s4 retains independent checks, unsupported-case repair and substantive interpretation; excess repair lowers savings.
No model chooses comparables or predicts a value autonomously. Any ordinary working-analysis save stays fully retained without a gate.
unknowns: Actual repeat-calculation effort and existing native tables
research_questions: Replay a real equipment forecast and count input verification, repeated entry and sensitivity checks.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario formulas and unit regression checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 20 repeat-calculation points less 1.5 upkeep. A rare collectible has sparse, incompatible comparables; retain bespoke forecasting and calculate only 3 points of compatible time-sensitivity arithmetic: 3 minus 1.5 = 1.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain identity, condition and valuation opinions while reducing specified comparisons, arithmetic and report restatement.
role.ambitious_version: No automated valuation authority or new service is justified by these provisional estimates.
